sar.narrative: This report concerns suspected fraudulent online activity involving customer C13487 and card C13487-K1. On 2016-11-15 and 2016-11-22, two online transactions totaling $187.33 were conducted in billing region 191.0. The transactions were carried out using a specific device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) and routed through an anonymous proxy. This activity is highly suspicious because the customer's card is historically used almost exclusively in person, with only 2 of 71 prior transactions occurring online. Furthermore, graph analysis shows this exact, rare device profile was used as a new device on 19 other cards belonging to 19 different customers between 2016-11-14 and 2016-11-22, indicating a coordinated fraud ring. The total exposure for this specific customer's episode is $187.33.
